components.name: Discord Login Button
components.description: The one blurple action that starts Discord sign-in.
components.css: .ds-btn-discord { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: #5865F2; color: #fff; font-family: 'Google Sans Flex', 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; outline: none; transition: background-color 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-discord:hover { background: #4752C4; } .ds-btn-discord:active { background: #3C45A5; transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-discord:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #2b2d31, 0 0 0 4px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.8); }

components.css: .ds-btn-action { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; height: 48px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: #f2f3f5; color: #1e1f22; font-family: 'Google Sans Flex', 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; outline: none; transition: background-color 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-action:hover { background: #dbdee1; } .ds-btn-action:active { background: #c4c9ce; transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-action:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #2b2d31, 0 0 0 4px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.8); } .ds-btn-action[aria-disabled='true'] { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1); color: #b5bac1; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.name: Status Banners
components.description: Tinted inline status in three tones: what happened, then the next step.
components.css: .ds-banner { display: flex; gap: 12px; margin-top: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid; border-radius: 10px; font-family: 'Google Sans Flex', 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.625; } .ds-banner p { margin: 0; } .ds-banner svg { flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 2px; } .ds-banner-error { border-color: oklch(0.704 0.191 22.216 / 0.3); background: oklch(0.704 0.191 22.216 / 0.1); color: oklch(0.885 0.062 18.334); } .ds-banner-warning { border-color: oklch(0.828 0.189 84.429 / 0.3); background: oklch(0.828 0.189 84.429 / 0.1); color: oklch(0.962 0.059 95.617); } .ds-banner-success { border-color: rgb(35 165 90 / 0.3); background: rgb(35 165 90 / 0.1); color: oklch(0.962 0.044 156.743); } .ds-cmd { padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; background: oklch(0.879 0.169 91.605 / 0.15); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.9em; }

components.name: Progress List
components.description: Hairline-divided rows showing what has been read from maimai DX NET, with an inline Retry on failure.
components.css: .ds-progress { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; border-top: 1px solid #3f4147; border-bottom: 1px solid #3f4147; font-family: 'Google Sans Flex', 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; color: oklch(0.985 0 0); } .ds-progress li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; height: 44px; font-size: 14px; } .ds-progress li + li { border-top: 1px solid #3f4147; } .ds-progress-name { flex: 1; } .ds-waiting .ds-progress-name, .ds-progress-note { color: #b5bac1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-btn-inline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; margin-right: -8px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.985 0 0); font-family: 'Google Sans Flex', 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; outline: none; } .ds-btn-inline:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06); } .ds-btn-inline-error { color: oklch(0.885 0.062 18.334); } .ds-btn-inline-error:hover { background: oklch(0.704 0.191 22.216 / 0.1); } .ds-btn-inline:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.8); } .ds-spin { animation: ds-spin 1s linear infinite; } @keyframes ds-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-spin { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
maibot lives inside the player's Discord habit, so the web side borrows Discord's own dark surfaces rather than shadcn's neutral greys: a near-black, faintly blue ground, one slightly lighter raised card, hairline borders, and Discord's blurple held back for the single action that leaves for Discord. The bar is the finish of Discord's own login screen, not a dashboard template.

Density is low and the voice is quiet. A surface shows a small wordmark, a direct heading, one supporting line, and the action. Status is spoken in tinted inline banners that say what happened and what to do next. Copy is English, sentence case. Where a surface shows the player's own maimai data (the upload preview), density rises to a scannable reading list, and that data is allowed to wear maimai's own images and difficulty colours; the room around it stays Discord's.

Motion is restrained: the main card fades in and rises 8px over 500ms with ease-out; content that replaces a loading placeholder only fades in over 200ms, so the entrance never plays twice; a preview panel that appears beside the card fades in over 500ms after a 150ms delay. Everything turns off when reduced motion is requested.
keyCharacteristics: Cool Discord darks (blue-tinted near-black ground, lighter card, hairline border).
Blurple reserved for the Discord action; the other main action is Discord's light filled button; quiet actions are Discord's grey.
One raised card on desktop that dissolves to full-bleed content on small screens; data surfaces add a wider preview panel beside it.
Tinted inline status banners (error, warning, success) with a Phosphor icon and recovery copy.
Player data in maimai's own visual language, confined to the data.
One entrance motion plus a short swap fade, reduced-motion safe.

rules.name: The One Blurple Rule
rules.body: Blurple at full strength fills only the Discord action. Elsewhere it appears only as atmosphere: a radial haze at 14% opacity across the top 28rem of the viewport, and text selection at 40%.

rules.name: The Discord Darks Rule
rules.body: Dark surfaces use the cool Discord values (ground, card, hairline, quiet grey), never shadcn's stock neutral dark greys. The overrides go on an inner wrapper inside the `.dark` element, because the unlayered `.dark` rule beats utilities placed on the same element.

rules.name: The Data Wears maimai Rule
rules.body: maimai's difficulty colours and DX NET images belong to the player's data (rows, tiles, chips, plates), never to the shell, cards, buttons or banners.

rules.name: The Literal Command Rule
rules.body: A bot command the player must type is set in JetBrains Mono inside a small tinted chip; prose around it stays in the sans.

rules.name: The Aligned Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number a player compares (ratings, counts, achievements, DX scores, judgements) uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: Only top-level containers cast a shadow; anything inside them separates by tone or hairline.

dos: **Do** set dark surfaces on Discord Ground with one Raised Card and a Hairline border.
**Do** keep blurple fill for the Discord action, with hover and active steps from the palette.
**Do** use the Light Action button for a surface's main non-Discord action, and Discord Grey for quiet actions.
**Do** put status in a tinted inline banner with a Phosphor icon and recovery copy.
**Do** set bot commands in JetBrains Mono inside a small tinted chip.
**Do** use tabular figures for every number a player compares.
**Do** use the single fade-and-rise entrance (8px, 500ms, ease-out), a 200ms fade for content swapped in after loading, and turn both off for reduced motion.
**Do** drop the card and panel frames below 640px and let content sit full-bleed.
donts: **Don't** use shadcn's stock neutral dark greys on a maibot surface; use the Discord darks.
**Don't** spend blurple on headings, links, borders, or secondary buttons.

**Don't** use an official SEGA / maimai look for the site's own chrome (shell, cards, buttons, banners). The exception is player data on the upload preview (`/update-data`), which may use maimai DX NET's own images: rating plate, class and course badges, title plate, overview icons, and maimai's difficulty colours as row and tile tints.
